unintendedEffects.effect: Phase 7 registers V2 with the global Pauser while V2 is still paused (L606), 3 txs before V2.unpause() (L614). Every EYE-funded Pauser.pause() in that window reverts EnforcedPause() and pauses nothing. On a run halted there, the runbook's :preview also reverts at phase0, because the tolerance covers V1 only.
unintendedEffects.evidence: fork-logs/r33-test_P7W_registeredWhilePausedWindow.log: P7-after-register(V2)|REVERTED|err=0xd93c0665 (also after Antimatter.setPauser and register(Antimatter)); HALTED_P7|preview run()|globalPause(phase0) ... first failing registrant: 0x5582…8161; after unpause SUCCEEDED 27. Control fork-logs/r33-test_P7W_fixOrderingControl.log: unpause-before-register never reverts. Resume convergence: fork-logs/r33-test_P7W_haltedStateBroadcastResumeConverges.log
unintendedEffects.classification: unintended (transient: 3 txs of the Ledger session; indefinite if the run halts inside it). Contradicts story-084's 'stays live all session'.

unintendedEffects.effect: The aggregate principal floor counts a V1 staker's permissionless userMigrate self-exit during the Migrating window as V2 principal loss. The cutover itself is correct: every other staker migrates and the exiter is paid to their wallet. Despite that, :verify reverts 'V2 booked total below pre-migration principal floor (067)', the post-verify :preview reverts the same way, and a halted run cannot be resumed.
unintendedEffects.evidence: fork-logs/r33-test_SX_selfExitBetweenTxs_verifierFalseFailsOnFloor.log: SELF_EXIT principal 5.4999 DOLA, paid 5.4999 DOLA; floor 1222483056933011776952 vs v2Staked 1217223596276947632021; verifier + preview revert on floor. Control fork-logs/r33-test_SX_controlNoSelfExit_verifierPasses.log: 29 users re-checked, PASS. Resume: fork-logs/r33-test_SX_haltedResumeCannotFinish.log: resume reverts on the DOLA floor, USDC never initiated, V2 left paused and unregistered.
unintendedEffects.classification: unintended false-negative in a safety gate. No funds lost, but it raises a false loss alarm and blocks resume.

unintendedEffects.effect: The OWNER ETH balance (0.005642012 ETH at 25981150) covers the 46-tx run only at the pinned 0.3 gwei, leaving 0.000147 ETH. At >=0.31 gwei, the node's upfront balance check (gasLimit*price) rejects tx #37 (USDe migrate) and halts the run mid-Phase 6. The package.json runbook tells the operator to 're-check base fee before signing' but gives no ETH budget, and the script has no balance pre-flight.
